bear_assumptions: USD 6.50 normalized EPS at 14x if copper and by-product prices normalize, Peruvian grades remain weak, project spending rises, and higher debt and stock-dividend dilution constrain per-share value.
base_assumptions: USD 7.50 normalized EPS at 18x if 2026 production stabilizes, current projects remain adequately funded, and metal prices moderate without a severe down-cycle.
bull_assumptions: USD 8.50 normalized EPS at 22x if strong copper and by-product prices persist, grades recover, and Tia Maria advances on schedule without material cost or jurisdictional deterioration.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if normalized scenario asymmetry becomes favorable through a lower price or stronger production, grade, cost and project evidence; downgrade if metal prices, grades, cash cost, jurisdiction, project execution, leverage, dilution or cash conversion deteriorate.
